row.evidence: LeadSquared's help centre documents Okta/generic SAML and OIDC sign-in (enabled by contacting support) and says users on the IdP and LeadSquared must share the same email address; no SCIM endpoint appears in the help centre or the API docs, where users are managed through the REST UserManagement.svc API.
row.notes: New row. Sales CRM pricing: Sales Pro $60/user/mo and Sales Super $100/user/mo billed annually; Marketing Automation is priced per account (Marketing Pro $2000, Marketing Super $3500). SSO (Okta OIDC, Okta/generic SAML, Azure AD OIDC, Google sign-in) is enabled per account by LeadSquared support; no plan gate is published, so sso_plan is null. Users must already exist in LeadSquared with the same email; no JIT or SCIM is documented. Users cannot be deleted, only deactivated (then optionally marked obsolete). The REST User Management API (create, update, activate, deactivate, mark obsolete, teams, sales groups) uses account access/secret keys and the pricing page lists the API framework on both Sales plans. No Okta OIN app (okta.com/integrations/leadsquared/ 404) or Microsoft Learn tutorial found. 'None' is by absence (rule 5). The sales pricing page returned 403 to curl and render.cjs (ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES); plan prices were read through WebFetch.

plans.notes: Pricing page lists 'API Framework' on both Sales plans (read via WebFetch).

plans.name: Marketing Pro
plans.notes: Marketing Automation product, priced per account.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented in the help centre sitemap (816 articles) or the API docs sitemap (385 pages). SSO requires the user to already exist with the same email. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: Access Key and Secret Key passed as accessKey/secretKey query parameters; host URL is region-specific (api.leadsquared.com, api-us11, api-in21, api-in22, api-ir31, api-ca12).

endpoints.purpose: Create a user (FirstName, EmailAddress, Role mandatory; custom fields, manager, team, sales groups)
Mark a deactivated user obsolete so the email can be reused
Get a user by email address
Add users to a sales group
Remove users from a sales group

rate_limits.text: 429 Too Many Requests when API calls exceed 25 in 5 seconds.

limitations.text: Users cannot be deleted, only deactivated (and then marked obsolete).

user_api.notes: Role is set with the Role parameter (Administrator, Marketing_User, Sales_Manager, Sales_User); permission templates have their own CRUD endpoints (not captured). Pricing page lists the API framework on both Sales plans (WebFetch read).

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/leadsquared/ returns 404; LeadSquared's own guide has customers build a custom Okta OIDC or SAML app.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial (leadsquared-tutorial 404); LeadSquared documents a customer-registered Azure AD app (OIDC).

jumpcloud.notes: LeadSquared says it has no JumpCloud-specific documentation and points to its generic SAML/OIDC steps.

fallbacks.notes: No JIT documented; SSO users must already exist with a matching email.
